amendments.because: A model's judgment can't be proven by required tests; a structural check is deterministic
amendments.done_when: The story template has a '## New and existing repos' section above Risks, saying what a fresh init or adoption gets, what an existing repo gets on upgrade, and naming a test for each; the cold read reports a story whose section is missing or covers only one side; the review instructions check the upgrade path of an existing repo; the fix brief and skill say a fix states both sides in one line. One command-level test: a cold read of a story without the section reports it.

done_when: The story template has a '## New and existing repos' section above Risks, saying what a fresh init or adoption gets, what an existing repo gets on upgrade, and naming a test for each; forge read refuses a story doc without that section with one plain line naming it, as it does for other malformed docs, and the cold-read instructions ask the reader to check both sides; the review instructions check the upgrade path of an existing repo; the fix brief and skill say a fix states both sides in one line. One command-level test: forge read on a story without the section refuses with that line.

findings.body: The only test that checks the actual cold-read finding is skipped unless live Codex is enabled and installed, and the supplied close run explicitly skipped it. The required tests workflow also leaves it disabled (.github/workflows/forge.yml:23); the added smoke step is optional and conditional on credentials. The passing offline test checks only prompt delivery: its reader returns "No findings." by default (tests/test_story.py:59). Consequently, required validation can pass without proving the command-level behavior promised by Done-when. Make the existing real-command test run as required validation without silently skipping it; this does not require a new command interface.

why: Features get planned and reviewed for Forge's own repo or a fresh init only, so existing client repos on older Forge versions get skipped or broken on upgrade
